note: Score each expected_behavior line independently. These are authored evaluations, not executed results.

scenarios.title: Concurrent claim
scenarios.query: Two agents need to work from separate sessions on the same roadmap. Establish coordination before either edits a guarded registry.
expected_behavior: Checks for project configuration before claiming enforcement
Acquires a scoped lease before the guarded edit
States TTL and the release path, including failure

scenarios.title: Race-free id reservation
scenarios.query: Two sessions will append decisions at the same time. Give each a unique id without scanning and incrementing locally.
expected_behavior: Uses the reservation mechanism instead of local max-plus-one
Journals the run that reserved the id
Reads back the durable append before acting on it
Does not put credentials in argv or logs

scenarios.title: Submodule completion
scenarios.query: The member repository is committed, pushed and green, but the umbrella still points to the previous commit. Finish the coordinated work.
expected_behavior: Identifies the parent pointer as unfinished work
Verifies the member commit is reachable upstream
Updates and verifies the parent pointer
Releases the held claim and reports residue
